lies.name: says yes to a change and does not apply it
lies.does: Acknowledges a change to a live authorization (cycle, plan, billing date, free period, scheduled end) and applies nothing; on creation, a line-items field is accepted and dropped.

lies.name: applies one of two changes under a single success
lies.does: With two changes in one request, applies one and drops the other, answering one success.

lies.name: creates a duplicate for every equal request
lies.does: Every authorization request creates a new authorization, even with the reference of an existing one.

lies.name: the search answers a part without error
lies.does: The search returns part of the matches without an error, ignores our reference, and carries fewer fields than the read by id.

lies.name: an amount change sends no notice
lies.does: Changing the amount of an authorization sends no notice on any channel.

lies.name: notices come late, repeated or never
lies.does: A notice arrives late, repeated or never; a refund arrives as three deliveries in two formats; a charge arrives once per channel.

lies.name: a rejected charge counts as a charge
lies.does: Counts a rejected charge attempt as a charge, and the attempt status does not say whether money moved.

lies.name: charges late and in batches
lies.does: A charge lands in the first batch after the hour it was due, at minute :02, not at the instant asked.

lies.name: adds a free period on its own
lies.does: Adds a free period by itself when the first charge is in the future.

lies.name: hands back a broken approval link
lies.does: The approval link carries activation=true, which opens a page that does not exist.

lies.name: an open approval link never expires
lies.does: An authorization nobody approved stays pending forever; its link never expires.

lies.name: a pause never resumes on its own
lies.does: A paused authorization is never resumed by the provider.

lies.name: says a refundable charge cannot be refunded
lies.does: Refuses a refund as not refundable (code 2084) when the same charge does accept another amount.

rules.name: a card token is single use
a refund without its idempotency key fails before any business validation
an amount below ARS 15 or above ARS 2.000.000 is refused with the exact message
a repeated refund moves no money and answers an empty body
a paused authorization refuses every change but lets itself be cancelled
a failed cycle takes four attempts on one record, then the provider pauses
a paused authorization is not charged
on resume, the next charge date moved on without charging
the last charged date is the last attempt, not the last charge
a card change emits a zero-amount validation charge on both channels

simulations.name: the provider does the work but the answer is lost on the way
simulations.why: A network case, not a measured lie: the code must survive not knowing whether its request landed.

simulations.name: the network is cut before the request reaches the provider
simulations.why: A network case, not a measured lie.

simulations.name: notices arrive out of order
simulations.why: WH-3 did not observe it (deliveries came in causal order in three runs), so it cannot be a lie of the list, yet the code must resist it.
